title: Dual-channel E-stop safety relay
goal: A reader must be able to trace two independent emergency-stop channels through a safety relay and its monitored contactor feedback loop.

rubric.must: Two separate emergency-stop devices labelled CH A and CH B are visible.
The safety relay visibly identifies separate S11-S12 and S21-S22 input channels.
A safety relay labelled 24 VDC and SIL3/PLe is visible.
A labelled MANUAL RESET pushbutton is visibly wired to the safety relay.
Two distinct safety contactor coils labelled KM1 and KM2 are visible.
Normally closed mirror contacts for both KM1 and KM2 are visibly traced back as EDM feedback.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Both stop channels are visibly independent from their E-stop contacts to S11-S12 and S21-S22, the reset sits on Y1-Y2, and the two contactor mirror contacts return in series to the external device monitoring input. Terminal designations match a real safety relay.
